editor.text:
OSCILLATOR LAB

1. Open Live Oscillator fullscreen.
2. Turn the amplitude, frequency, and damping knobs.
3. Drag the plot to pan; use + / − to zoom.
4. Open Equation Editor and select a number to adjust it with the editor knob. The plot follows saved edits.
5. In Sampled Curves, select Live Oscillator — sampled curves from Import connected CSV / JSON.
6. Export those samples as CSV or JSON.

Math Lab knobs override the corresponding editor parameter until you reselect the equation source.

Save JSON in the app header preserves this whole graph, including your edits and parameter settings.
